does: Reads each message from the website form and records which team should get it: Training, Speaking, Consulting, or a person to review.
does_not: Deliver messages to the teams or contact customers.
design_reason: Sends a message to a person whenever it sees more than one reasonable reading. Requests for two services always go to a person.
harmful_action: a message sent to the wrong team, or routed on its own when it needed a person
person_group: vague, empty, two-service, or trick messages
not_tested: How the team handles the review pile
known_limits: Safety depends on the assistant noticing when a message could fit more than one team
If more than about 5 messages arrive in one minute, the extras go straight to a person; none are lost
A security key will be replaced before launch
We can run a test set written by the client's own staff before the pilot
confirmations_needed: Confirm our service definitions: Training is hands-on skill building, Speaking is a talk or keynote, Consulting changes how work gets done
Ask each team to report any message that isn't theirs
Decide how teams receive messages during the pilot
